title: D1 fix round 2: sync .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md with the CLAUDE.md spec-review threshold line (gate red on T-0151)
spec: Fix round for T-0151 (branch task/T-0151). Work in this task's worktree, cut from task/T-0151. The T-0151 gate is red on exactly one test: tests/test_goals.py test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists, because T-0151 changed the CLAUDE.md "Always" list line about spec review (complexity 5 → 6, now reading "complexity ≥6 (pool.toml [review].spec_review_min) through a spec review first") and .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md copies the Never and Always lists verbatim from CLAUDE.md (C-O3 rule). Change ONLY .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md so its copied line matches the current CLAUDE.md line byte for byte (look at how the test derives the expected text: it reads the repo-root CLAUDE.md lists; reproduce that). Run `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_goals -q` and then the full suite. Do not touch CLAUDE.md, daemon.py or tests. Commit on the task branch when green. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
Committed clean, working tree clear.

## Summary
Fixed the red gate on T-0151: `.orchestrator/prompts/planner.md`'s "Always" list line 6 still said "complexity ≥5 through a spec review first" while CLAUDE.md had been updated (by T-0151) to "complexity ≥6 (pool.toml [review].spec_review_min) through a spec review first". Copied CLAUDE.md's line verbatim into planner.md, per the C-O3 copy-verbatim rule.

**Files changed:**
- `.orchestrator/prompts/planner.md` (1 line changed, no other lines touched)

**Test output (failures only): none — everything green**
- `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_goals -q` → `Ran 24 tests in 4.709s — OK`
- `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -q` (full suite) → `Ran 165 tests in 29.404s — OK`
- `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` → exit 0, no failure output

Committed on `task/T-0154` as `4501d91`.

+ State machine per execute task: `queued` → (depends_on merged, complexity ≥ `spec_review_min` → `spec_review` first,
+ on `spec_review_tier`) → dispatched to an executor → `done` → gated (`tests-green.sh`) → complexity ≤
+ `direct_merge_max` merges straight away; complexity between `direct_merge_max` and `two_reviews_from` spawns one
+ `review` task, tiered to whichever model did not execute the task; complexity ≥ `two_reviews_from` spawns two,

+ Planner to re-spec regardless of what the other review said. These four thresholds live in `pool.toml`'s
+ `[review]` table (defaults: `spec_review_min = 6`, `direct_merge_max = 3`, `two_reviews_from = 7`,
+ `spec_review_tier = "sonnet"`); policy and the cost measurement that motivated it are noted there.

- bus lock before acting, so a crash-and-retry never re-runs a stage.

+ on the task json under the bus lock before acting, so a crash-and-retry never re-runs a stage.

  or `autostart = false` disables it), and `uv run orchestrator daemon` takes the same single-instance lock so two loops
  never run at once; `orchestrator daemon --once` runs a single pass without the lock.
